# ReadmeForge — AI Agent Specification & Context (llms.txt)
> https://readmeforge.dev | An open-source, client-side GitHub profile README generator and visual studio.

## Project Summary
ReadmeForge generates production-grade, GitHub-safe markdown profiles with zero required runtime servers.
It supports two primary creation workflows:
1. **Visual Wizard**: Step-by-step modular form with real-time preview and resume import.
2. **/developer Mode**: Raw-mode Monaco JSON editor with instant two-way synchronization, Zod schema validation, plugin registry drawer, and live markdown preview.

## Canonical Schema
All profiles conform to the `ReadmeConfig` specification:
- **`version`** (string): Current schema version (e.g. `"1.0.0"`).
- **`title`** (string): User profile title or project headline.
- **`settings`** (object):
  - **`user`** (object): `github` (required string), `name`, `role`, `bio`, `location`, `pronouns`, `status`.
  - **`theme`** (string): `"dark"` | `"light"` | `"auto"`.
  - **`accentColor`** (string): Hex color (e.g. `"#8b5cf6"`, `"#10b981"`).
  - **`badgeStyle`** (string): `"for-the-badge"` | `"flat"` | `"flat-square"` | `"plastic"`.
  - **`align`** (string): `"left"` | `"center"` | `"right"`.
- **`sections`** (array of SectionConfig):
  - **`id`** (string): Unique identifier (e.g. `"sec-1"`).
  - **`type`** (string): One of the 15 registered plugin IDs below.
  - **`props`** (object): `{ content: Record<string, unknown>, styles: Record<string, unknown>, state?: string }`.

## Modular Plugin Registry (15 Plugins)
1. `header-bio`: Custom title, subtitle, status badge, pronouns, location, and avatar.
2. `capsule-banner`: Modern curved/waving capsule-render SVG hero banner.
3. `mascot-bio`: Side-by-side or stacked animated mascot character with custom bio card.
4. `skill-icons`: Multi-icon SVG skill cluster with auto-wrapping and dark/light mode.
5. `readme-typing-svg`: Dynamic typewriter headline via pure SVG animation.
6. `markdown-badges`: 150+ technology, language, framework, database, and tool badges.
7. `github-readme-stats`: Overall GitHub telemetry (stars, commits, pull requests, reviews).
8. `streak-stats`: GitHub contribution streak and total lifetime contributions.
9. `activity-graph`: Waveform contribution graph and activity trendlines.
10. `github-profile-trophy`: Gamified achievement trophies ranked by stars, commits, and PRs.
11. `pie-chart`: Top programming languages breakdown (donut, pie, or compact bar).
12. `pinterest-image`: Aesthetic image showcase resolved from direct Pinterest links or search queries.
13. `visitor-counter`: Non-invasive profile visitor counter badge.
14. `snk`: Animated retro snake game eating through user's contribution grid.
15. `social-links`: Social media, portfolio, blog, and community contact badges.

## AI Agent Integration & CLI
AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Devin, Antigravity, Copilot) can execute ReadmeForge directly:
- **CLI Generate**: `npx readmeforge generate --username <handle> --archetype <id>`
- **List Archetypes**: `npx readmeforge list`
- **Agent Skill Install**: `npx readmeforge skill-install`
- **MCP Server (stdio)**: `npx readmeforge mcp` (exposes `generate_profile_readme` & `list_archetypes`)
- **Agent Skill Spec**: `/.agents/skills/readmeforge/SKILL.md`

## 8 Built-in Archetypes
1. `wow-3d-city-cat`: 3D isometric contribution city with peeking kitten header and glowing language telemetry.
2. `bento-signal-dashboard`: High-density dark glass bento grid with live signal telemetry.
3. `metrics-telemetry-dashboard`: Simon Lecoq / lowlighter-style metrics dashboard.
4. `neon-craftsman-owl`: Purple/magenta capsule banner, celebratory owl mascot, and achievement badges.
5. `minimal-light-unicorn`: Clean light mode aesthetic with rainbow unicorn developer mascot.
6. `dark-glass-devops`: Constellation mesh banner, terminal window, and tech badges.
7. `cyber-terminal`: Neon cyan retro terminal header with animated typing SVG.
8. `pinterest-lofi-aesthetic`: Cozy anime/lo-fi coffee workspace visual moodboard.

## Machine Endpoints & URLs
- **Web App**: https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app
- **/developer IDE**: https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer
- **JSON Schema API**: https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/api/schema
- **Agent Context (Full)**: https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/yuvraj-thakur-exe/readmeforge

## Sample Valid Configuration
```json
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "title": "Full-Stack Engineer Profile",
  "settings": {
    "user": {
      "github": "octocat",
      "name": "Alex Mercer",
      "role": "Full-Stack & Systems Engineer",
      "bio": "Building fast, reliable web applications and distributed backends.",
      "location": "San Francisco, CA",
      "pronouns": "they/them",
      "status": "Exploring Rust & Turbopack"
    },
    "theme": "dark",
    "accentColor": "#8b5cf6",
    "badgeStyle": "for-the-badge",
    "align": "left"
  },
  "sections": [
    {
      "id": "typing-header",
      "type": "readme-typing-svg",
      "props": {
        "content": {
          "lines": ["Building high-concurrency systems", "Open source contributor & maintainer"],
          "color": "8b5cf6"
        },
        "styles": {}
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "gh-stats",
      "type": "github-readme-stats",
      "props": {
        "content": { "showIcons": true, "includeAllCommits": true },
        "styles": {}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
